ti.title: ምስጋና ይኹን
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ሓይሉ ረቂቕ’ዩ ብመንፈስ ዝዓዪ
ከይተዋግአ ጸላእቱ ዘጉዪ
በዓል ግርማ’ዩ ትርኢቱ ዘንደልህጽ
ትእዛዝ ቃላቱ ንምድሪ ዘንቀጥቅጥ (2)
[[/chorus]]

ምስጋና ይኹን ኣምልኽዎ ተገዝኡ ነገስታት ናይ ምድሪ
ስገዱሉ ፍርሑ ንፈጣሪ

ሕዝቡ ዝሓሊ ዘመሓድር ንጉሥ
ትጉህ ጓሳ’ዩ ፈጺሙ ዘይታኸስ
ብሓንቲ ዓይኒ ዝመዝን ዳኛ’ዩ
ፍትሒ ዘውጽእ ቅኑዕ ፈራዲ’ዩ (2)

ሕዝቡ ዝሓሊ . . .

ti_ro.title: Msgana ykhun
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Tzaz qalatu nmdri zenqetqt (2)
[[/chorus]]

Msgana ykhun amlkhwo tegezu negestat nay mdri
Sgedulu frhu nfetari
Haylu reqiq’yu bmenfes zayi
Keytewaga tselatu zeguyi
Beal grma’yu tritu zendelhts
Hzbu zhali zemehadr nguss
Tguh gwasa’yu fetsimu zeytakhes
Bhanti ayni zmezn danya’yu
Fthi zewts qnu feradi’yu (2)
Barya zmesl nkhbri barotu
Mhret zezz hadag ntselatu
Bfqru zret zmelkh amlakh
Tegbaratus dnqi teamrat (2)
Hzbu zhali . . .
